title: Booking rack: Peak ticket
topics: Greedy choices, dynamic programming and backtracking
summary: Each booking is [start,end] with start < end and occupies [start,end). Sort by end then start ascending; accept a booking if it starts at or after the last accepted end. Produce accepted durations in acceptance order. Negative times are allowed. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
Half-open booking cards compete for a single press whose next job may start exactly when the previous one ends. Ivo is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Each booking is [start,end] with start < end and occupies [start,end). Sort by end then start ascending; accept a booking if it starts at or after the last accepted end. Produce accepted durations in acceptance order. Negative times are allowed.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement bookingRackPeakTicket(drawers, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Greedy interval selection. Each booking is [start,end] with start < end and occupies [start,end). Sort by end then start ascending; accept a booking if it starts at or after the last accepted end. Produce accepted durations in acceptance order. Negative times are allowed. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n log n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with greedy interval selection. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
